page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No notes in the margins. A printed mark (a small dash) stands at the right margin beside the line "in capite de Reprehensione". Signature "Y 2" at the foot.

main_text.p: inexplicabile est, vt exitum interrogato nullum praebeat. quanquam alij τὸ ἄπορον,genus: alij (vt Hermagoras) speciem fecerunt.

Quomodo tanta vis erat sophisticæ? Quoniam (vt Gellius scribit) lex est Dialecticæ disciplinæ, si de quapiam re quæratur, disputetúrque, atque ibi quid rogere, tum ne amplius quid dicas, quàm id solùm, quod es rogatus,aut aias, aut neges: eámque legem qui non seruant,& aut aliter quàm funt rogati respondent,exiftimantur rudes indoctíque esse, neque disputandi morem & confuetudinem tenere.

Quotuplex istius ἀπόρᾳ[?] siue perplexitatis vitium est? Multiplex omnino. nä varia Stoici genera confinxerunt. Cicero quidem in veteri Rhetorico quadruplicem Reprehensionis modum exponit: sed qui ad hunc duplicem reuocari debeat. Verba illius hæc sunt:Omnis argumentatio reprehenditur, si aut ex iis quæ sumpta sunt non conceditur, (id est negatur) aliquod vnum pluráve:aut his cócesis,cóplexio confici ex his negatur: aut si genus ipsum argumentationis vitiosum ostenditur, aut si cótra firmam argumétationem alia æquè firma,aut firmior ponitur. Nā tertius modus in primo continetur perspicuè. Quartus autem ad deliberationes tantummodo pertinet. Sed tamen tota illa Ciceronis disputatio, quæ est in capite de Reprehensione lib. de Inuent.r. diligenter obseruanda est.

page.notes: The Greek word after "istius" is uncertain; it may be ἀπορία or ἄπορα, so it is marked [?]. The first Greek phrase "τὸ ἄπορον" is copied with its accent as printed. The printed mark at the right margin by "lib. de Inuent.r." is a reference or printer's mark, not a note; it is not transcribed. The scan is slightly faded at the right edge, so line-end letters there may be imperfect.
